g.text: Delivery speed: a gateway release (the newest process acts; new steps in bold)
the platform starts the new revision
take the lease at once: epoch e+1 (compare-and-swap)
Starting: serves verbs, webhooks, host reports;
no plan, no start, no merge, no promotion;
waits up to 90 s for the final snapshot
the old process sees epoch e+1 (within 15 s)
+ await the running sync-board at most 45 s, then kill it;
every mutating step already checks the epoch
+ slot ledger, footprints, host-full blocks, runtime health
their streams reconnect to the new process
rebuild runtime records from the task history (existing)
+ day budget: every Start and overflow run since 00:00 UTC, host-full ones excepted
run Reconcile hosts once (retry once; else the scheduled run)
ledger = snapshot + task history, corrected by the reports;
sessions that ended during the handover are freed here
first sweep: board, claims, item state comments
holds, durable budgets, merge entries, evidence, flow times
deployments, Sign-offs and smoke tasks read back;
due timers recomputed from their finish times
first plan pass; triggers queued while Starting run now
at SIGTERM: final snapshot, release the lease (existing)
